description: Opt-in Renovate preset for Nix repositories.
Renovate is the only flake.lock writer: first-party inputs update one at a time at any time, and every other input updates through the weekly lock-file maintenance PR.

packageRules.description: Raise the Go minimum-version directive in a dedicated, review-required PR; Renovate does not bump this directive by default.
Keep exact Go toolchain directive updates with the Go toolchain PR.

Per-input flake updates need a release timestamp. git-refs supplies none, so inputs under a release-age hold (every non-first-party input) get no per-input PR and update only through weekly lock-file maintenance; first-party inputs have no hold and still update at any time.
